npmErrors: npm error `npm ci` can only install packages when your package.json and package-lock.json or npm-shrinkwrap.json are in sync. Please update your lock file with `npm install` before continuing.
npm error Missing: fsevents@2.3.2 from lock file

reasons: Rejected: the supplied fixed verification failed during formal dependency preparation (`npm ci`, exit 1), so the required actual headless-Chromium smoke never ran.

The failure is reproducible from the candidate manifests: `package-lock.json` records `playwright@1.58.2` with optional dependency `fsevents@2.3.2` (lines 16147–16164), but its only locked `node_modules/fsevents` entry is version 2.3.3 (lines 14989–15002). This is exactly the lock/package inconsistency reported by npm: “Missing: fsevents@2.3.2 from lock file.” Consequently the candidate does not provide an installable locked browser runtime as required.

The source structure otherwise substantially targets the harness contract: `.npmrc` sets `playwright_browsers_path=0`; both Playwright packages are exact, equal 1.58.2 versions in `package.json` and lock; the wrapper sets `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0` before spawning the local CLI; and the smoke sets it before import, launches Chromium, serves/asserts a local DOM page, routes non-local requests to abort, and closes browser/server. These unexecuted implementation details cannot overcome the failed dependency-install acceptance gate.
